'''1996 GenCon Open''' was a Star Wars CCG Open. [[Michael Mikaelian]] defeated [[Joe Alread]] in the finals.<ref name="inquest">Michael Mikaelian, "Star Wars World Championships", ''InQuest'' #22 (February 1997), p. 14. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/inquest-magazine-issue-22 InQuest Magazine Issue 22], Internet Archive.</ref>
